Latest news

2026.03.31Lift Operation Resumption Notice

12:30

【Lift Operation Resumption Notice】

We sincerely apologize for the delay. Lift operations are now gradually resuming.

Please feel free to use the lifts.

Please note that upper lifts remain suspended. Kindly check the latest updates before use.

Click here for lift operation updates.

11:30

【Lift Suspension Notice】

Due to strong winds and approaching lightning in the upper area of the ski resort, all operating lifts are temporarily suspended to ensure safety.

Lift operations will resume as soon as safety has been confirmed. We kindly ask for your patience.

Guests currently skiing are requested to follow the instructions of staff or in-resort announcements and evacuate promptly to the nearest facility.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding and cooperation in ensuring everyone’s safety.

Click here for lift operation updates.
